author: claude
summary: Implements huggingface_voice_upload plan task 004 (engine-asset inclusion), previously flagged owner-gated/untouched in 2026-07-12-hf-upload-gaps-and-publish-wiring.json. Owner clarified the scoping question directly: the published sample must be the one already generated by the variant whose engine asset is being published (never mix a sample with a different model's asset), and the README must state which model produced the sample. While implementing this, found and fixed a second, more serious pre-existing bug the scoping discussion surfaced: the export endpoint's sample lookup checked the voice ROOT for samples/preview.mp3 or sample.mp3 -- paths that never exist on any real installed voice (samples live inside each variant's own subdirectory) -- so sample_mp3_bytes was silently empty (b'') in every real export, shipping a zero-byte sample and a non-playable Hub card. Confirmed via a live export against a real installed voice before this fix.

files.change: New _resolve_publish_variant(voice_dir) helper: picks the variant to publish using the same default-variant fallback chain as bundles.export_voice_bundle (state.json default_variant -> directory named 'Default' -> first alphabetically). export_hub_voice rewritten to resolve one variant_dir via this helper, read sample.mp3 from it (replacing the old voice-root lookup), read the variant's engine id from its profile.json, and collect any present MODEL_ASSET_NAMES files from that same variant into engine_assets keyed by engine_id. Passes engine_assets and sample_engine_id through to export_hf_voice_bundle.

export_hf_voice_bundle gains engine_assets: dict[str, list[tuple[str, bytes]]] | None and sample_engine_id: str | None params. When engine_assets is given, writes each engine's files under assets/<engine_id>/ in the export zip (omitted entirely, not an empty dir, when there are no resolvable assets). When sample_engine_id is given, appends a '## Sample' section to the generated README noting which engine/model produced the sample, without modifying bundles.generate_readme_md.

_make_voice_root fixture rewritten to build the REAL on-disk layout (variant subdirectory with profile.json + sample.mp3, optional latent.pth) instead of a voice-root-level samples/preview.mp3 that no real voice has -- the old fixture shape was itself hiding the bug this change fixes. 5 new tests: real variant sample bytes actually end up in the export, same-variant engine asset included under assets/<engine_id>/, README names the generating model, no assets/ entry when the variant has no engine asset, and state.json's default_variant is honored over alphabetical fallback (two variants, non-alphabetically-first one wins).

revert_checked: git stash of app/domain/voices/huggingface.py + app/api/routers/voices_huggingface.py: all 5 new tests failed (4 explicit failures plus the sample-bytes assertion), confirming they exercise the real fix; restored and green.
verified_live: Re-ran the export endpoint against the real 'Dark Fantasy' voice used earlier this session -- before this fix, samples/preview.mp3 in the exported zip was 0 bytes and the README had no widget: block (the samples[] synthesis never triggered because sample_mp3_bytes was always falsy); confirmed the root cause was the voice-root lookup never matching this voice's actual layout (voices/Dark Fantasy/Default/sample.mp3, not voices/Dark Fantasy/sample.mp3).
